sources.primary_title: Oracle and AMD Expand Partnership to Help Customers Achieve Next-Generation AI Scale
sources.verified_angle_summary: Oracle and AMD have expanded their strategic partnership to deploy an unprecedented AI supercluster on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Beginning in Q3 2026, Oracle will be the first hyperscaler to offer a publicly available AI supercluster powered by an initial deployment of 50,000 AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs. This deployment utilizes the AMD 'Helios' rack design and advanced 'Vulcano' networking to handle massive AI training workloads. AMD, a Platinum Sponsor at DeepFest 2026, is actively showcasing this capability and partnership. This angle is highly specific, avoids generic cloud positioning, and focuses on a concrete, massive-scale hardware deployment timeline that intersects with the DeepFest 2026 event.
sources.verified_key_facts: Oracle and AMD expanded their partnership for AI infrastructure; Oracle to deploy 50,000 AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs starting Q3 2026; Deployment utilizes AMD Helios rack design and Vulcano networking; AMD is a Platinum Sponsor at DeepFest 2026; Each MI450 GPU provides up to 432 GB of HBM4 memory; Architecture enables direct hardware-coherent networking via UALink protocol.
